# DreamAvatar Stage

Characters & Collectibles · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/dream-avatar-stage`

Real consumers: **3** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

The full-body DreamAvatar art layer for a caller-owned stage: `standing` adds a low ambient glow, `cutout` preserves the underlying scene, and `fullBleed` supplies a cinematic backdrop and head-focused composition.

> **Guidance:** Place this component inside a position-relative stage whose width, height, overflow, and placement belong to the caller.

Use DreamAvatar Portrait for framed profile crops and semantic profile reveals.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dreamAvatar` | `DreamAvatarVisual` | yes | — | The DreamAvatar whose full-body art fills the stage. |
| `variant` | `DreamAvatarStageVariant` = `"fullBleed" \| "standing" \| "cutout"` | yes | — | `standing` adds an ambient glow, `cutout` preserves the scene, and `fullBleed` adds a cinematic backdrop. |

### `dreamAvatar`: the `DreamAvatarVisual` model

| Field | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `imageNumber` | `string` | no |  |
| `name` | `LocalizedString` | no |  |
| `title` | `LocalizedString` | yes |  |
| `portraitFocus` | `DreamAvatarPortraitFocus` | yes | Normalized head position used to center subject-aware crops. |

## Usage

### Standing figure

Full-body art over the ambient selection glow.

```tsx
import { DreamAvatarStage } from "src/cumulus/components/hud/DreamAvatarStage";

<div style={{ position: "relative", width: 320, height: 480 }}>
  <DreamAvatarStage dreamAvatar={dreamAvatar} variant="standing" />
</div>
```

### Scene-preserving cutout

Full-body art with no component-owned backdrop.

```tsx
<div style={{ position: "relative", width: 320, height: 480 }}>
  <DreamAvatarStage dreamAvatar={dreamAvatar} variant="cutout" />
</div>
```

### Cinematic showcase

Head-focused full-body art over the cinematic backdrop.

```tsx
<div style={{ position: "relative", width: 320, height: 480 }}>
  <DreamAvatarStage dreamAvatar={dreamAvatar} variant="fullBleed" />
</div>
```
